pages.title: Qubit
pages.text: A two-level quantum system held in superposition: zero and one at once, weighted by complex amplitudes, until a measurement forces it to choose. Carrying it is an exercise in restraint, because looking too closely collapses it. It feels slightly cold, and its faint glow flickers between two colours without ever settling.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Quantum Entangler I trapped one half of an Entangled Photon Pair inside a Quantum Dot. The dot's two energy levels held the photon's state cleanly, and I had my first stable qubit: a bit that refused to be either value.
